title: Comment adverbs; viewpoint adverbs; focus adverbs
summary: Наречия-комментарии (**frankly, surprisingly, fortunately**), наречия точки зрения (**financially, technically, politically**) и фокусные наречия (**only, even, also, too, either, especially**) и их позиция.
ru:
## Комментарии говорящего: наречие ко всему предложению
Наречия-комментарии (**sentence adverbs**) выражают отношение говорящего к тому, что он сообщает. Обычно стоят в **начале** предложения, отделяются запятой, но возможны и в середине. Они относятся ко всей мысли, а не к глаголу.
> **Surprisingly**, nobody complained. — К удивлению, никто не жаловался.
> **Fortunately**, we caught the earlier train. — К счастью, мы успели на ранний поезд.
> She **obviously** hadn't read the contract. — Она, очевидно, не читала договор.
Группы:
- **оценка**: fortunately, unfortunately, surprisingly, sadly, curiously, oddly;
- **уверенность**: obviously, clearly, evidently, apparently, presumably, undoubtedly;
- **оценка поступка**: foolishly, wisely, kindly, generously — *He **foolishly** ignored the warning.* — Он по глупости проигнорировал предупреждение.
- **манера высказывания**: frankly, honestly, briefly, seriously, personally — *Frankly, I'm not convinced.*

## Один корень — два значения
Позиция показывает, комментарий это или наречие образа действия.
> **Clearly**, she was lying. — Очевидно, она лгала. (комментарий)
> She spoke **clearly**. — Она говорила чётко. (способ)
> **Sadly**, he waved goodbye. — К сожалению, он помахал на прощание. / He waved goodbye **sadly**. — Он помахал на прощание с грустью.
> **Stupidly**, he answered. — Глупо, что он ответил. / He answered **stupidly**. — Он ответил по-глупому.
Если после наречия запятая и оно в начале — почти всегда комментарий.

## Точка зрения: viewpoint adverbs
Они показывают, в каком аспекте верно сказанное: **financially, politically, technically, legally, theoretically, officially, economically, medically, environmentally**. Эквивалент — оборот *from a ... point of view*.
> **Financially**, the project was a disaster. = From a financial point of view...
> **Technically**, you're right, but nobody follows that rule. — Формально вы правы...
> **Legally speaking**, the contract is valid. — С юридической точки зрения договор действителен.
- Сочетание **-ally + speaking** возможно: *politically speaking*, *strictly speaking*.

## Фокусные наречия
Они подчёркивают слово или часть фразы: **only, just, even, also, too, as well, either, especially, particularly, mainly, simply, merely**. Позиция критична:
> **Only** Anna passed. — Прошла только Анна. / Anna **only** passed. — Анна всего лишь сдала.
> **Even** the manager was surprised. — Даже менеджер удивился.
> I didn't **even** read it. — Я даже не прочитал.
> She plays the piano and **also** the violin. — Она играет на пианино, а ещё и на скрипке.

## too, as well, either, also
- **also** — в середине: *She also speaks Greek.* (в начале — с запятой: *Also, we need...*)
- **too / as well** — в конце: *Can I come too? I can come as well.*
- **either** — только в **отрицательных** предложениях: *I don't like it, and she doesn't either.* ~~doesn't too~~
- **so / neither / nor** — отдельные конструкции с инверсией: *So do I. Neither can I.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I don't know him too.~~ → I don't know him **either**.
- ~~She also speaks Greek too.~~ → She **also** speaks Greek. / She speaks Greek **too**.
- ~~Unfortunate, we missed the train.~~ → **Unfortunately**, we missed the train.
- ~~I even didn't see him.~~ → I **didn't even** see him.
en:
## Speaker's comment: an adverb for the whole sentence
Comment adverbs (**sentence adverbs**) express the speaker's attitude to what is being said. They usually come at the **beginning**, followed by a comma, but can also go in the middle. They modify the whole statement, not just the verb.
> **Surprisingly**, nobody complained.
> **Fortunately**, we caught the earlier train.
> She **obviously** hadn't read the contract.
Groups:
- **evaluation**: fortunately, unfortunately, surprisingly, sadly, curiously, oddly;
- **certainty**: obviously, clearly, evidently, apparently, presumably, undoubtedly;
- **judging an action**: foolishly, wisely, kindly, generously — *He **foolishly** ignored the warning.*
- **way of speaking**: frankly, honestly, briefly, seriously, personally — *Frankly, I'm not convinced.*

## One root, two meanings
The position shows whether the adverb is a comment or a manner adverb.
> **Clearly**, she was lying. (comment: it is obvious)
> She spoke **clearly**. (manner)
> **Sadly**, he waved goodbye. (I feel sad that he did) / He waved goodbye **sadly**. (in a sad way)
> **Stupidly**, he answered. (it was stupid of him) / He answered **stupidly**. (in a stupid way)
An adverb at the start followed by a comma is almost always a comment.

## Viewpoint adverbs
They show in which respect the statement is true: **financially, politically, technically, legally, theoretically, officially, economically, medically, environmentally**. They are equivalent to *from a ... point of view*.
> **Financially**, the project was a disaster. = From a financial point of view...
> **Technically**, you're right, but nobody follows that rule.
> **Legally speaking**, the contract is valid.
- The pattern **-ally + speaking** is possible: *politically speaking*, *strictly speaking*.

## Focus adverbs
They highlight a word or phrase: **only, just, even, also, too, as well, either, especially, particularly, mainly, simply, merely**. Position matters:
> **Only** Anna passed. / Anna **only** passed. (she did no more than pass)
> **Even** the manager was surprised.
> I didn't **even** read it.
> She plays the piano and **also** the violin.

## too, as well, either, also
- **also** — mid position: *She also speaks Greek.* (at the start with a comma: *Also, we need...*)
- **too / as well** — at the end: *Can I come too? I can come as well.*
- **either** — only in **negative** sentences: *I don't like it, and she doesn't either.* ~~doesn't too~~
- **so / neither / nor** — separate patterns with inversion: *So do I. Neither can I.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I don't know him too.~~ → I don't know him **either**.
- ~~She also speaks Greek too.~~ → She **also** speaks Greek. / She speaks Greek **too**.
- ~~Unfortunate, we missed the train.~~ → **Unfortunately**, we missed the train.
- ~~I even didn't see him.~~ → I **didn't even** see him.
structure:
## Три типа наречий
| Тип | Что делает | Примеры | Позиция |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Comment** | отношение говорящего | fortunately, obviously, frankly | начало / середина |
| **Viewpoint** | аспект утверждения | financially, legally, technically | начало |
| **Focus** | выделяет слово | only, even, also, especially | перед выделяемым словом |

## Формулы
> **Наречие,** + предложение: **Surprisingly,** nobody came.
> подлежащее + **наречие** + глагол: She **obviously** knew.
> **-ally** + **speaking**: **legally speaking**, **strictly speaking**
> **also** (mid) / **too, as well** (end) / **either** (негатив., end)
> **only / even / just** + выделяемое слово: **Only** Anna / not **even** Anna

## Сравнительная таблица
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **Honestly,** | говорю откровенно | **Honestly,** I don't mind. |
| **He answered honestly.** | способ ответа | He answered **honestly**. |
| **Technically,** | формально / с технической стороны | **Technically,** it's allowed. |
| **Even** | даже (неожиданно) | **Even** experts disagree. |
| **Only** | только | **Only** experts disagree. |

exercises.title: Подберите наречие
exercises.instruction: Вставьте наречие по смыслу (подсказка по-русски). Предложение начинается с большой буквы — регистр не важен.

items.text: {{Unfortunately|Sadly|Regrettably}}, the flight was cancelled at the last moment.
{{Obviously|Clearly|Evidently}}, she was upset; her eyes were red.
He {{foolishly|stupidly|unwisely}} left the door unlocked, and the bike was stolen.
{{Financially|Financially speaking}}, the project was a disaster.
{{Technically|Technically speaking|Strictly speaking|Officially}}, you're right, but nobody follows that rule.
{{Personally}}, I prefer the older version of the design.
{{Politically|Politically speaking}}, the decision was risky, but it was popular with voters.

exercises.title: Фокусные наречия
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово: **also, either, even, only, especially, too**.

items.text: She speaks French and Spanish, and she {{also|even}} speaks Arabic.
I don't like cold weather, and I don't like rain {{either}}.
{{Even}} the experts struggled to understand the document, let alone the beginners.
I've {{only}} met her once, so I can't say what she's like.
I like all kinds of fruit, {{especially|particularly}} mangoes.
I didn't {{even}} read the email; I just deleted it.
My brother isn't coming, and my cousin isn't coming {{either}}.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя наречия-комментарии, точки зрения или фокусные наречия.

items.prompt: Start with Frankly, ... about something you do not enjoy.
items.sample: Frankly, I don't enjoy waking up early, even on holidays.

items.prompt: Describe a plan or decision using Financially, ... or Environmentally, ...
items.sample: Financially, working from home saves me a lot of money.

items.prompt: Write about something that surprised you (Surprisingly, ...).
items.sample: Surprisingly, the exam was easier than I'd expected.

items.prompt: Name something you like, especially, and something you don't like either.
items.sample: I like most sports, especially tennis. I don't like football, and I don't like rugby either.
